06e8c98bccd36df6.job_title: Quality Assurance Manager Four Seasons Resort at The Red Sea
06e8c98bccd36df6.company_name: Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia
06e8c98bccd36df6.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Quality Assurance Manager to join its team in Umluj and Al Wajh. This full-time role is essential for maintaining service excellence, monitoring operational standards, and driving continuous improvement across all departments within the property. The position is suited for hospitality professionals with 2-5 years of experience who are committed to delivering world-class guest experiences. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and oversee the property’s quality assurance programs. Monitor and audit operational performance to ensure alignment with Four Seasons standards. Analyze guest feedback and identify areas for service enhancement. Collaborate with department heads to implement corrective actions and best practices. Facilitate training sessions and workshops to enhance service culture and quality awareness. Lead the property’s Forbes Travel Guide and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) preparation, audits, and follow-up actions. Prepare regular reports on quality performance and improvement initiatives. Act as a brand ambassador, ensuring a seamless and exceptional guest journey. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a relevant quality assurance or hospitality management role. Demonstrated commitment to delivering high standards of guest service. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based within the upcoming Four Seasons Resort on Shura Island, part of The Red Sea destination in Saudi Arabia. The Red Sea destination is being developed with a focus on sustainable practices and will feature luxury beachside accommodations, a yacht marina, leisure facilities, retail offerings, and an 18-hole golf course. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, multiple dining outlets, meeting spaces, a marine discovery centre, and various recreational facilities including a spa, tennis courts, and pools. Company Overview Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hospitality company known for its commitment to service excellence and high operational standards. The Red Sea project represents a significant development in Saudi Arabia's tourism sector, aiming to provide a luxury travel and lifestyle experience while adhering to sustainable development principles.

062f1e816fc3b179.description: About Almarai Almarai Company, established in 1977, is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and a leading food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in MENA, holding market leadership across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. The company has sustained growth for over five decades by providing nutritious products, guided by its principle: “Quality you can trust.” Almarai’s product portfolio includes dairy products, juices, beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish, seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L’usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, Farm’s Select, Ice Leaf, Almira, Seama, Oska, IVAL, Almara Pro, Premier Chef, and Bakemart. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. The Role of Transport Officer Almarai is seeking a Transport Officer for a full-time position in Al-Kharj. This role is central to ensuring the efficient and compliant distribution of finished products to depots across KSA and the Gulf region. The Transport Officer will work within a framework that prioritizes safety, adherence to transport plans, and cost-effectiveness. Responsibilities Ensure the distribution of finished products to depots throughout KSA and the Gulf. Adhere strictly to established transport plans. Execute distribution activities in a safe and compliant manner. Maintain a continuous focus on cost efficiency in all transport operations. Qualifications and Experience 3 years of relevant experience in transport or logistics. Benefits Almarai offers a competitive remuneration package, which includes generous leave, comprehensive medical coverage, and a discretionary bonus. The company also provides opportunities for training and professional development.

064b9366f01480ad.description: Job description About the job ZAKAT, VAT & WHT COMPLIANCE SPECIALIST - SAP, CPA, ACCA, CA OR SOCPA Purpose: Own the tax rules, controls and ZATCA-facing procedures that the monitoring toolkit enforces, and keep SAR audit-ready. Key responsibilities Write procedures for handling ZATCA queries, managing zakat and tax assessments, and filing objections and appeals for future years. Set up the record-keeping framework for expenses, assets and payments so evidence is retrievable during assessments. Define the VAT/WHT validation rules, control points and thresholds that Role 1 builds into the toolkit. Review monthly VAT and WHT returns using the toolkit; investigate and clear exceptions before filing. Prepare the zakat base computation and supporting schedules; reconcile to the ERP output. Act as liaison with ZATCA and external auditors during reviews and inspections. Update internal tax policies and train finance staff on the new controls. 060748a6718c99bc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد المخاطر المهنية في بيئات العمل المختلفة، وقياس مستويات العوامل البيئية، ومراقبة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في مواقع العمل. اقتراح وتطبيق أساليب وإجراءات لتفادي تأثيرات هذه المخاطر على العاملين. تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمستويات المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين الظروف البيئية. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لتفادي تأثيراتها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر المهنية المختلفة وتقييمها. معرفة جيدة بأساليب قياس العوامل البيئية مثل الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج. القدرة على تصميم برامج لمنع الأمراض المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد وتقييم المخاطر. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإعداد التقارير والتوصيات. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية واللوائح ذات الصلة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، ويكون العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة لتحديد المخاطر ومراقبة الإجراءات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

063f2c226823f97a.description: Job description Job Description Overview AtkinsRéalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team in the Middle East. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including: Land-use and development demand. Real estate asset mix and scale. Housing and employment requirements. Social infrastructure needs. Development capacity and absorption. Development and infrastructure phasing. Investment priorities. The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors. Your role Urban and Spatial Economics Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes. Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery. Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes. Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure. Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability. Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable. Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions. Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills. Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality. Commercial awareness and understanding of the factors influencing real estate and development decisions. Ability to manage defined workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed programmes and budgets. Confidence working within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. Ability to operate effectively where information or project requirements may be evolving. Proactive, collaborative and willing to take responsibility for assigned deliverables. 06eb4f0f87ec5e9e.description: The Manager – Government Relations is responsible for managing all regulatory, permitting, and licensing activities required across URED&s development and property portfolio. The role ensures timely and compliant engagement with all relevant Saudi government authorities, safeguarding project delivery timelines and URED& operational licences. The GR Manager builds and maintains productive relationships with key regulatory bodies including Municipality (Baladiya), Civil Defence, MOMRA, SEC, NWC, and other relevant authorities, ensuring all approvals, connections, and certifications are secured within target timeframes. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Regulatory Permits, Licences &Approvals ▪ Manage the end-to-end process for all regulatory certificates, permits, and licences across URED projects within target timelines. ▪ Obtain building permits, Civil Defence certificates, completion certificates, and occupancy approvals. ▪ Manage issuance of required governmental approvals, certifications, and registrations for all URED departments. ▪ Monitor and track all permit and approval statuses through a structured tracker (Excel/Wrike). Public Utility Connections ▪ Manage electricity connections with SEC (Saudi Electricity Company) within target timelines. ▪ Coordinate water and sewage connections with NWC (National Water Company). ▪ Ensure all public utility activations are completed prior to project handover. Government Relations & Authority Management ▪ Build and maintain productive relationships with Baladiya, Civil Defence, MOMRA, SEC, NWC, and other regulatory bodies. ▪ Liaise with ministries and government entities to resolve project-specific regulatory issues. ▪ Represent URED professionally in all government interactions. ▪ Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting UREDs development activities and communicate updates to management. Policies, Procedures & Governance ▪ Develop and maintain GR department policies and procedures in line with Saudi law and URED objectives. ▪ Ensure all GR processes are documented, consistent, and auditable. ▪ Manage formal correspondence and official letters with government entities. ▪ Ensure all GR documentation is properly filed and maintained within URED systems. Team Leadership ▪ Direct, manage, and develop the GR Coordinator. ▪ Allocate tasks and responsibilities within the GR team. ▪ Ensure the Coordinator understands their KPIs and accountability frameworks. FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES & DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY ▪ Reports directly to the CTSO. ▪ Financial authority as per URED Delegation of Authority (DoA). ▪ Authority to engage and negotiate directly with government authorities on URED& behalf. ▪ Authority to approve GR-related correspondence and formal letters. ▪ No authority to commit URED to any financial, legal, or contractual obligations without CTSO approval. ▪ Authority to sign off on permit applications and regulatory documentation via DocuSign. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Building permits obtained within 4–6 weeks of application. ▪ Civil Defence certificate secured within 2–4 weeks of project completion. ▪ Completion certificates obtained within 4–6 weeks of practical completion. ▪ SEC electricity activation completed within 6–8 weeks of connection application. ▪ Water and sewage connections completed within 6–8 weeks of NWC application. ▪ 100% of regulatory submissions made within required timelines. ▪ Zero regulatory or authority-related project delays attributable to GR function. ▪ Zero fines or penalties for regulatory non-compliance. INTERNAL& EXTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS Internal ▪ CTSO — Permit status reporting, escalation of regulatory issues, strategic alignment. ▪ Construction Team — Permit and approval coordination for project delivery. ▪ Design & Engineering — Regulatory submission support for planning and design approvals. ▪ UAPM Operations — Operational licence and connection coordination. ▪ Finance — Government fee processing and budget tracking. External ▪ Baladiya (Municipality) — Building permits, completion certificates, occupancy approvals. ▪ Civil Defence — Fire safety certificates and inspections. ▪ MOMRA — Regulatory compliance and planning approvals. ▪ SEC (Saudi Electricity Company) — Power connection applications and activations. ▪ NWC (National Water Company) — Water and sewage connections. ▪ Other relevant ministries and regulatory bodies as applicable. Qualifications ▪ Bachelor&Degree in Business Administration, Law, Engineering, or related field (preferred). ▪ Diploma with extensive relevant experience will be considered. Experience Minimum 6–8 years of experience in Government Relations, regulatory affairs, or permit management in Saudi Arabia. ▪ Proven experience managing permits and approvals for real estate development projects. ▪ Strong established relationships with Baladiya, Civil Defence, SEC, and NWC. Behavioral Competencies ▪ Excellent relationship management and interpersonal skills. ▪ Negotiation and influence with government officials. ▪ High integrity and professional conduct. ▪ Organized, systematic, and deadline-driven. ▪ Proactive and solution-oriented. ▪ Clear communication — bilingual (Arabic and English).
